description.value:
Rank 4 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: Special
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Ranged Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: 1 Round
  • Range: Self
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: Yes

Setting aside everything for the shot, you begin pouring your Ki into the next attack.

You may spend an amount of Ki up to a max equal to 5x your Character Level. At the beginning of your next turn, you may make a Combo Attack Roll, no Action Economy required. On a hit, you deal your Weapon Damage Die + 2d12 Ki Damage for every incrememnts of 10 Ki that you spend.

While within the round, all creatures have Advantage on Attack Rolls against you and you have Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws you make.

When you would Charge this Technique, the Action Economy for the Charge is 1 Round.

system.requirements: 1 *Simple or Martial Ranged Weapon* that you are proficient with.
